_comment: Files too heavy to keep in git - GitHub refuses anything over 100 MB, and a 65 MB pack would be committed twice (pack tree plus overlay source). tools/fetch_remote_files.py puts each one where it belongs before anything reads those folders, and refuses any file whose sha256 does not match.

files.reason: requested addition (cobblemon 1.7.3+1.21.1); 122.8 MiB is over GitHub's per-file limit, so it is fetched rather than committed
